scientific_assessment.reason: Within one Qwen3 release, the 4B model is the smallest whose calibrated prior, with the v3 exploration floor, beats the hand rule in a majority of cells (7 of 9). Its selective prior picks better entrants in all nine cells and it matches the 4B-2507 anchor in eight. The 0.6B model ranks the linear world almost perfectly but is near chance in the interaction worlds, and dominates in 4 of 9. The 1.7B model's readout carries almost no linear signal, and it dominates in only 1 of 9. Size is therefore not monotone below 4B, and a smaller model is not a drop-in replacement.
